VIRIDIS_POWER_TEMP_DEXTERITY_POWER.title: Temporary Dexterity
VIRIDIS_POWER_TEMP_DEXTERITY_POWER.descr: At the end of your turn, lose the [gold]Dexterity[/gold] gained from this effect.
VIRIDIS_POWER_SYMBIOSIS_POWER.title: Symbiosis
VIRIDIS_POWER_SYMBIOSIS_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you [gold]Cultivate[/gold] a card, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
VIRIDIS_POWER_ROOT_NETWORK_POWER.title: Root Network
VIRIDIS_POWER_ROOT_NETWORK_POWER.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold], plus 1 for each card left in your Cultivate Pile after its countdowns resolve.
VIRIDIS_POWER_ANCIENT_TREE_POWER.title: Ancient Tree
VIRIDIS_POWER_ANCIENT_TREE_POWER.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy and [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number of cards in your Cultivate Pile{HasBonusBlock: plus {BonusBlock}|}.
VIRIDIS_POWER_CANOPY_POWER.title: Canopy
VIRIDIS_POWER_CANOPY_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy for each card in your Cultivate Pile.
VIRIDIS_POWER_MOTHER_PLANT_POWER.title: Mother Plant
VIRIDIS_POWER_MOTHER_PLANT_POWER.descrip: At the start of your turn, if your Cultivate Pile is empty, [gold]Cultivate[/gold] up to 2 cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_TUNDRA_POWER.title: Tundra
VIRIDIS_POWER_TUNDRA_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_MYCORRHIZA_POWER.title: Mycorrhiza
VIRIDIS_POWER_MYCORRHIZA_POWER.descripti: Whenever you [gold]Cultivate[/gold] a card, draw 1 card.
VIRIDIS_POWER_TREE_RING_MARK_POWER.title: Tree Ring Mark
VIRIDIS_POWER_LEAF_VEIN_POWER.title: Leaf Vein
VIRIDIS_POWER_LEAF_VEIN_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you [gold]Harvest[/gold] a card, draw 1 card.
VIRIDIS_POWER_FOREST_LORD_POWER.title: Forest Lord
VIRIDIS_POWER_DEEP_ROOT_POWER.title: Deep Root
VIRIDIS_POWER_DEEP_ROOT_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you [gold]Cultivate[/gold] a card, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_FLOWER_BUD_POWER.title: Flower Bud
VIRIDIS_POWER_FLOWER_BUD_POWER.descripti: The first time you [gold]Cultivate[/gold] a card each turn, [gold]Grow[/gold] 1.
VIRIDIS_POWER_NO_CULTIVATE_POWER.title: Cannot Cultivate
The next card you [gold]Cultivate[/gold] that has a countdown starts with 1 turn remaining.
VIRIDIS_POWER_LANDED_ROOT_POWER.title: Landed Root
VIRIDIS_POWER_LANDED_ROOT_POWER.descript: Whenever one of your cards hits an enemy, gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_DELAYED_DRAW_POWER.title: Delayed Draw
VIRIDIS_POWER_DELAYED_DRAW_POWER.descrip: At the end of this turn, if your Cultivate Pile has any cards, draw 1 card.
VIRIDIS_POWER_DELAYED_GROW_POWER.title: Delayed Growth
VIRIDIS_POWER_DELAYED_GROW_POWER.descrip: At the end of this turn, [gold]Grow[/gold] 1.
VIRIDIS_POWER_SPRING_CYCLE_POWER.title: Spring Cycle
VIRIDIS_POWER_SPRING_CYCLE_POWER.descrip: At the start of every second turn after gaining this Power, [gold]Grow[/gold] 3.
VIRIDIS_POWER_WORLD_TREE_POWER.title: World Tree
VIRIDIS_POWER_WORLD_TREE_POWER.descripti: At the start of your turn, [gold]Cultivate[/gold] 1 card from your Hand. Whenever you [gold]Harvest[/gold] a card, add a random card of the same rarity to your Hand.
VIRIDIS_POWER_PRIMORDIAL_SPORE_POWER.des: Whenever you empty your Cultivate Pile, deal 20 damage to ALL enemies.
VIRIDIS_POWER_HUMUS_CYCLE_POWER.title: Humus Cycle
VIRIDIS_POWER_HUMUS_CYCLE_POWER.descript: Whenever you [gold]Harvest[/gold] a card, add an unupgraded copy at its base cost to your Hand.
VIRIDIS_POWER_COIN_STREAM_POWER.title: Coin-Friendly Livestream
VIRIDIS_POWER_COIN_STREAM_POWER.descript: This turn, gain 2 Gold for each Viewer you gain.
VIRIDIS_POWER_SLOW_START_SONG_POWER.desc: At the start of your turn, transform up to {Amount} Status cards into [gold]Heavenly Melody[/gold], starting with your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Then increase the number of cards transformed by 1.
VIRIDIS_POWER_KAOZI_POWER.title: Kaozi
VIRIDIS_POWER_KAOZI_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Viewer[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_ANTI_STOMP_POWER.title: Anti-Stomp
VIRIDIS_POWER_ANTI_STOMP_POWER.descripti: The first {Amount} cards you play each turn do not grant [gold]Viewer[/gold].
VIRIDIS_POWER_CHUANZI_POWER.title: Troll
VIRIDIS_POWER_CHUANZI_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, randomly gain 1 [gold]Vigor[/gold] or 1 [gold]Stretch[/gold] {Amount} times.
VIRIDIS_POWER_FARMER_FORM_POWER.title: Farmer Form
VIRIDIS_POWER_FARMER_FORM_POWER.descript: At the start of your turn, reduce all countdowns in your Cultivate Pile by {Amount} more. Each time a countdown reaches 0, [gold]Harvest[/gold] {Amount} additional {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
VIRIDIS_POWER_CUTE_COMMOTION_POWER.title: Cute Commotion
VIRIDIS_POWER_CUTE_COMMOTION_POWER.descr: Whenever you play Niang Xiao, Niang Yao, or Niang Yang, draw {Amount} {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
